target: forge.sh check — one ok|warn|fail<TAB>message line per finding, exit 0 even with a failing finding
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
fx_run check; fx_show r
echo "bad_lines=$(printf '%s\n' "$FX_OUT" | grep -Evc $'^(ok|warn|fail)\t.+')"
[[ -n "$FX_OUT" ]] && echo has_lines=yes || echo has_lines=no
printf '%s\n' "$FX_OUT" | grep -qE $'^fail\t' && echo has_fail=yes || echo has_fail=no
printf '%s\n' "$FX_OUT" | grep -qi 'gitlab' && echo has_kind_finding=yes || echo has_kind_finding=no
fx_done
